#: Faster HDT-SMP settings: the header of the XML written out, and what the check of a ready file has to say.
smp.collisionUnnamed: a collision with a shape nobody names
smp.jointNowhere: a joint onto a bone that is neither in the file nor in the skeleton
smp.jointUndeclared: a joint onto a bone that <bone> never declares
smp.noBone: the skeleton has no such bone
smp.noPart: the mesh has no such part
smp.note:
SMP works collisions out from the vertices of mesh parts and does not read capsules on bones:
below are only the names of the parts the skin of the chains lies on. To hook the file to a part:
defaultBBPs.xml, <map shape="part" file="SKSE\Plugins\hdtSkinnedMeshConfigs\this file"/>.
smp.nothing: SMP was not given a single usable chain: nothing to write
smp.parts: the mesh parts the skin of the chains lies on: the shape comes from their vertices
smp.title: morphbench: Faster HDT-SMP settings
